sections.content: Start with the essentials. Build on them as your business grows.

items.title: What is included in Starter?
items.description: An editable website, product catalogue and support workspace.

items.title: Can I update my store content?
items.description: Edit supported text, images, links and section content in the visual builder.

items.title: Can products be purchased or quoted?
items.description: Products and services can offer direct purchase, quotation requests or display-only presentation, according to your catalogue setup.

items.title: Is AI generation included in Starter?
items.description: AI features and usage allowances are confirmed with your selected plan. Contact us to discuss your setup.
